t: This is The Hampstead Figure, an abstract bronze sculpture by F. E. McWilliam. It was commissioned by Basil Spence and completed in 1964 for the new Hampstead Civic Centre. In 2019 it was moved to where it stands now, on the Adelaide Road side of Swiss Cottage Library. McWilliam was a Northern Irish surrealist sculptor who worked chiefly in stone, wood and bronze.
